Visualization and interaction layer for cardiac electrophysiology signal
data. 'ggm' (Grammar of Electrograms) builds on the 'EGM' data backend
to view, annotate, and present electrograms. The signal store stays
canonical in 'EGM' (WFDB byte-seek reads); 'ggm' adds windowed access, a
multi-resolution overview, and a declarative grammar for animated and
print-ready figures. Sample index (integer) is the canonical key for
storage and joins, while time (seconds) is the display unit.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`build_pyramid()`](https://shah-in-boots.github.io/ggm/reference/build_pyramid.md)
  : Build the signal pyramid
- [`cache_example_data()`](https://shah-in-boots.github.io/ggm/reference/cache_example_data.md)
  : Download an example study to the local cache
- [`time_to_sample()`](https://shah-in-boots.github.io/ggm/reference/convert.md)
  [`sample_to_time()`](https://shah-in-boots.github.io/ggm/reference/convert.md)
  : Convert between sample index and time
- [`get_annotations()`](https://shah-in-boots.github.io/ggm/reference/get_annotations.md)
  : Query annotations over a window (not yet implemented)
- [`get_overview()`](https://shah-in-boots.github.io/ggm/reference/get_overview.md)
  : Whole-study overview (not yet implemented)
- [`get_window()`](https://shah-in-boots.github.io/ggm/reference/get_window.md)
  : Read a window of signal
- [`open_study()`](https://shah-in-boots.github.io/ggm/reference/open_study.md)
  [`is_study()`](https://shah-in-boots.github.io/ggm/reference/open_study.md)
  : Open a study
